answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. Regenerating from the API changed InjectTargetsOutput.inject_targeted from required to optional, and this PR touches InjectTargetsOutput.java. The fix is to regenerate and commit the types, not to re-run. The check is deterministic, so a retry will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
